explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/803: Janzer–Sudakov proved that for any k and large n, every n-vertex graph with ≥ n log n edges has an O(1)-balanced subgraph on m ≥ k vertices with ≫_k m√(log m)/(log log m)^{3/2} edges. The statement gives an absolute D and, for each k, a constant c > 0 with this property for all large n. Faithful.
